title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion

title: Node.js Heap Memory Leak — Global Cache Accumulation

title: API Gateway Cascading 504 Timeout — Payment Vendor Failure
description: Third-party payment processor StripeConnect is returning HTTP 500s with >30s latency, causing checkout-api-gateway to queue and exhaust all upstream worker threads.

deployment_history.commit: NO DEPLOYMENT — External vendor incident. StripeConnect status page: Investigating elevated error rates.
